'''Sources'''

Some of the information on this wiki comes from documents provided outside the wiki. One such source was made by robloxpro492 (tabmahmud), available [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Qn5jCohyIT9gdSLdriBsPx6GQnRc3F8fMDF2UljV-j4/edit?tab=t.0 here].

== Discord confirmation ==
The Original Hybrid transformation requirements were confirmed by the game's owner on Discord:
[[File:Original-hybrid-discord-confirmation.png|thumb|Confirmation of the Original Hybrid transformation requirements from the game's owner (Discord).]]
Translation: to become a hybrid, you must be level 5,000; the player transforming you must be at least level 3,000; it doesn't matter if you are a vampire or a werewolf; the Original Vampire gamepass is required; and the chance is 0.5%, depending on luck.

The owner has also stated a 0.1% chance (October 23, 2026 message: "Because I don't want a pandemic of hybrids is 0.1%"), so the rate has changed over time:
[[File:Original-hybrid-0-1-percent-message.png|thumb|The game's owner stating a 0.1% Original Hybrid transformation chance (Discord, October 23, 2026).]]

== Notice about hybrids ==
The game's staff asked players to stop opening tickets about how long or difficult it is to become a hybrid:
[[File:Hybrid-transformation-notice.png|thumb|Staff notice about hybrid transformation odds (Discord).]]
The chances of successfully becoming a hybrid are very low by design. Attempting the transformation requires an Original at level 5,000 and a werewolf at level 3,000 or higher. Success depends on luck and is not guaranteed — some players succeed in minutes, while others may spend hours or even days trying, which is normal. Staff cannot change the odds or guarantee a transformation, and tickets should be saved for actual issues.

== Update announcements (October 25, 2026) ==
The Witch Push ability, Vampire Minions, and the Beast Form Vampire come from announcements on the game's Discord, with further details from a helper in the questions channel. These announcements are the source for the Minions section on the Vampire page, the Beast Form Vampire page, and the Push ability on the Witch page.

== Update announcement (October 15, 2026) ==
The game's October 15, 2026 update announcement covered several bug fixes, the werewolf Alpha tag, over 20 new werewolf skins, and werewolf ability changes:
[[File:Werewolf-update-announcement-oct-15-2026.png|thumb|Werewolf update announcement from the game's Discord (October 15, 2026).]]
This announcement is the source for the October 15, 2026 Update section on the Werewolf page.

== Update announcement (October 26, 2026) ==
The game's October 26, 2026 update announcement ("Today's Updates — 10/26") added the Wolfsbane Potion, Mining XP, the Chest Swarm vampire ability, the /lib and /unlib private server commands, and the in-game compass, plus several fixes and adjustments:
[[File:Update-announcement-oct-26-2026.png|thumb|Update announcement from the game's Discord (October 26, 2026).]]
Added: Wolfsbane Potion to the Hunter's Shop (Humans become immune to werewolf infection for 20 minutes; it can be dropped, and another dose cannot be consumed while protection is active); Mining XP — 3 for coal, 6 for silver, 9 for rubies, before multipliers; Chest Swarm for vampires level 2000+ (the swarm strikes and drags the target before returning to the vampire; damage scales with level); /lib and /unlib commands (the owner can grant or revoke another player's private server time commands); the in-game compass (displays locations, distances, and directions, with a scrollable list).
Fixed or adjusted: the Original Hybrid's coffin now grants the level reward; damage from Dagger, Rapier, Throwing Knife, and White Oak Ash Dagger now scales with level and the human's Strength; a safeguard prevents the Witch from turning into a vampire when switching to the Witch slot during a transformation; the weapon shop now alerts players when purchase materials are missing; switching from Hybrid to Original Vampire now includes the option to revert to Hybrid if a slot is saved, and the Hybrid's level is no longer copied to a new Original slot; the Rapier's buttons and keys reset after death, and the Cross equipping/unequipping cycle in other races was removed; /recoverydata search range extended to 14 days, and the team swap log keeps the level in the correct slot; clashes no longer occur with a level difference of 500 or more.
This announcement is the source for the Mining XP section on the Mining page, the Wolfsbane Potion on the Items page, Chest Swarm on the Vampire page, and the /lib and /unlib lines on the Private Servers page.

== Vegan Vampire announcement (October 24, 2026) ==
The Vegan Vampire subspecies was announced on the game's Discord: a player who feeds only on rats earns the "Vegan Vampire" tag, working like the Cannibal Vampire system.
